newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to buy 27.8% stake in Toyota South Africa.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to buy 27.8% stake in Toyota South Africa.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp said on Wednesday that it had agreed to buy 27.8 percent of the shares outstanding in Toyota South Africa Ltd (Toyota SA) currently held by Johnnies Industrial Corp (Johnnic) of South Africa and its pension funds.
The total value of the shares is about 10 billion yen, the Japanese car maker said in a statement.
The agreed purchase of 11,301,008 shares of Toyota SA represents Toyota's first direct participation in the South African operations, which began in 1961, Toyota said.
Toyota has provided technology to Toyota SA, whose 100 percent unit makes Toyota models, but Toyota has had no equity relationship with Toyota SA so far.
The purchase would make Toyota the second largest individual shareholder of Toyota SA, Toyota said.
The statement did not say when the purchase would take place.
Toyota said the share purchase was part of an ongoing effort to open up global opportunities.
